```{r}
#| label: get-data-1

  data_dir,
```

```{r}
#| label: load-helpers

# Load helper functions for modular processing
source("vignette_helpers.R")
```

```{r}
#| label: precompute-all-data

# APPROACH 3: Pre-compute all signature data before rendering
# This separates computation from plotting, making debugging easier

all_signature_data <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(ID89_ID83_connection_example)), function(i) {
  compute_signature_data(
    ID89signature = ID89_ID83_connection_example$ID89_signature[i],
    catalog = ID89_ID83_connection_example$example_catalog[i],
    ID83signature = ID89_ID83_connection_example$ID83_signature[i],
    ID89_signatures = to.plot.all.ID89.signatures.final,
    ID89_catalogs = to.plot.all.ID89.catalogs,
    ID83_signatures = to.plot.all.signatures.final,
    ID83_catalogs = to.plot.WGS_PCAWG_HMF_indels.catalog,
    ID83_catalogs_no_polyT = to.plot.WGS_PCAWG_HMF_indels.catalog.no.polyT,
    ID476_signatures = final.Koh476.signatures,
    ID476_catalogs = to.plot.all.ID476.catalogs,
    assignment_matrix = ID89.mSigAct.assignment
  )
})

# Name the list for easier debugging
names(all_signature_data) <- ID89_ID83_connection_example$ID89_signature
```

```{r}
#| label: validate-precomputed-data

# Validate all data was computed correctly before rendering
# This catches computation errors before they appear in plot rendering
for (i in seq_along(all_signature_data)) {
  sig <- all_signature_data[[i]]
  if (is.na(sig$cosine89)) {
    warning(paste("Missing cosine89 for:", sig$ID89signature))
  }
  if (is.na(sig$cosine83)) {
    warning(paste("Missing cosine83 for:", sig$ID89signature))
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: render-all-sections
#| output: asis
#| fig-width: 19
#| fig-height: 4
#| echo: false

# APPROACH 2: Use knitr::knit_child with a template for each signature section
# Each iteration uses the child template, isolating errors to specific sections

for (i in seq_along(all_signature_data)) {
  # Set sig_data in the environment for the child template
  sig_data <- all_signature_data[[i]]

  # Render the child template for this signature
  # Errors will reference _signature_section.qmd with specific line numbers
  res <- knitr::knit_child(
    "_signature_section.qmd",
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  )
  cat(res, sep = "\n")
}
```
